description: Ungapped identity of Vam10p against all antisense reading frames of VPS5 orthologs, with a shuffled-query null
code:
import requests, time, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S = requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
EU="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"

TARGETS = {"S. cerevisiae S288C":"854235","S. paradoxus":"54633636","H. naganishii":"34528585",
 "K. africana":"13885848","N. dairenensis":"11497156","T. phaffii":"11533094",
 "T. delbrueckii":"11504303","Z. rouxii":"8201976","L. thermotolerans":"8293188",
 "K. lactis":"2895646","K. marxianus":"34715552","E. gossypii":"4620469",
 "E. cymbalariae":"11472381","H. blattae":"14492685"}
sm=S.get(EU+"esummary.fcgi",params=dict(db="gene",id=",".join(TARGETS.values()),retmode="json"),timeout=90).json()["result"]
def ef(acc,s,e,st):
    t=S.get(EU+"efetch.fcgi",params=dict(db="nuccore",id=acc,rettype="fasta",retmode="text",
      seq_start=s,seq_stop=e,strand=st),timeout=120).text
    return "".join(t.split("\n")[1:]).upper()
SEQS={}
for nm,gid in TARGETS.items():
    L=sm[gid]["genomicinfo"][0];a,b=int(L["chrstart"]),int(L["chrstop"])
    s,e,st=(a+1,b+1,1) if a<=b else (b+1,a+1,2)
    SEQS[nm]=ef(L["chraccver"],s,e,st); time.sleep(0.3)

bases="TCAG";aas="FFLLSSSSYY**CC*WLLLLPPPPHHQQRRRRIIIMTTTTNNKKSSRRVVVVAAAADDEEGGGG"
CODON={};i=0
for b1 in bases:
    for b2 in bases:
        for b3 in bases:
            CODON[b1+b2+b3]=aas[i];i+=1
def tr(s): return "".join(CODON.get(s[k:k+3],"X") for k in range(0,len(s)-2,3))
COMP=str.maketrans("ACGTN","TGCAN")
def rc(s): return s.translate(COMP)[::-1]
VAM10="MLFEVFGEVLASYIVSSKTKGELAFPVNNAPPDSLVAINCVVLFLRSAIGSCSGAKELIRSSALELSCSSSCGLPATDKPGSFHSGALSKSILSANEAVVSKSSLSFLSSFVDI"
q=np.frombuffer(VAM10.encode(),dtype="S1"); L=len(VAM10)

def best_ungapped(target_prot):
    t=np.frombuffer(target_prot.encode(),dtype="S1")
    if len(t)<L: return 0.0,-1
    best=0.0;bi=-1
    for s in range(len(t)-L+1):
        idt=float((q==t[s:s+L]).sum())/L
        if idt>best: best,bi=idt,s
    return best,bi

rows=[]
for nm,g in SEQS.items():
    r=rc(g); bb=0.0; bf=None
    for f in range(3):
        p=tr(r[f:])
        idt,pos=best_ungapped(p)
        if idt>bb: bb,bf=idt,(f,pos)
    # same-strand (sense) control: identity of Vam10p vs VPS5 protein windows
    rows.append(dict(species=nm, best_antisense_identity_pct=round(100*bb,1), frame_pos=str(bf)))

# null: shuffled VAM10 vs S. cerevisiae antisense frames
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
null=[]
r=rc(SEQS["S. cerevisiae S288C"])
frames=[tr(r[f:]) for f in range(3)]
for _ in range(200):
    sh="".join(rng.permutation(list(VAM10)))
    qq=np.frombuffer(sh.encode(),dtype="S1")
    b=0.0
    for p in frames:
        t=np.frombuffer(p.encode(),dtype="S1")
        for s in range(0,len(t)-L+1,1):
            v=float((qq==t[s:s+L]).sum())/L
            if v>b: b=v
    null.append(100*b)
null=np.array(null)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("best_antisense_identity_pct",ascending=False)
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print("\nNull (shuffled Vam10p vs S.cer VPS5 antisense frames): mean %.1f%%  95th pct %.1f%%  max %.1f%%"%(null.mean(),np.percentile(null,95),null.max()))

d=df[df.species!="S. cerevisiae S288C"].sort_values("best_antisense_identity_pct")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5))
ax.barh(d.species,d.best_antisense_identity_pct,color="#64748b")
ax.axvline(np.percentile(null,95),ls="--",c="#c2410c",lw=1.2)
ax.text(np.percentile(null,95)+0.4,0.1,"95th pct of shuffled-query null",color="#c2410c",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("Best ungapped identity to Vam10p (%), 3 antisense frames of the VPS5 gene")
ax.set_title("No Vam10p-like antisense ORF is detectable in VPS5 of 13 Saccharomycetaceae relatives")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
